set.exchanges_help: Tick the exchanges you use. Prices come from the first one that lists the pair; CoinGecko and exchange rates fill the gaps.
dca.log_note: Amounts are estimated at the current price. Edit them under Portfolio → Trades to match your fills.
rules.notify_off: Notifications are off — alerts only show here.
tip.start_rules.b: Alerts send a notification when something you care about happens, e.g. a coin falls 15% below what you paid.
watch.empty: Your watchlist is empty — add a coin with +
wiz.watch_note: Any coin on CoinGecko can be added later.
about.privacy_body: No telemetry, no accounts, no ads. The app only connects to the hosts listed below and refuses any other, over HTTPS only. With the proxy option on (expert mode), every request — including DNS — goes through Tor/Orbot or your SOCKS5 proxy. Your trades and settings stay on this phone.
m.home.sub: Your crypto at a glance, with a few notes from your assistant
m.home.widget_t: Your favorites on the home screen
m.home.widget_b: Add a widget to see your starred coins' prices without opening the app. It refreshes in the background.
m.widget.pick_coin_sub: Which coin should this widget show? Starred coins come first.
widget.empty_fav: Star coins in Maze Crypto → Prices to show them here.
widget.empty_nodata: Open Maze Crypto once to load prices.
m.watch.star_hint: Tap the star next to a coin to put it on your home-screen widgets.
m.watch.long_press: Tap a coin for its chart · hold for more options · ★ = on your widgets
m.search.label: Search
m.search.hint: Results from CoinGecko. Tap a coin to add it.
m.chart.touch_hint: Touch and drag to read a candle · pinch to zoom
m.chart.levels_b: Dashed orange lines you add yourself (Add level) to mark prices you care about.
m.hold.alloc_hint: Bar = current weight · white tick = target · amount = buy (+) or excess (−) to reach the target
m.plan.log_note: Amounts are estimated at the current price; edit the trades later to match your fills. Only for plans in your portfolio currency.
m.rules.sub: Rules you define; a notification when one becomes true
m.rules.notify_on: Notifications are on. Alerts are checked while the app is open and in the background.
m.rules.notify_off: Notifications are off — alerts only show here.
m.rules.bg: Checked in the background about every {n} minutes (Settings → Widgets).
m.rules.bg_off: Background refresh is off: alerts are only checked while the app is open.
m.ins.tech_help: Each coin's daily chart summed up. The guide below explains every measure.
m.set.widgets_help: Put prices on your home screen. Every widget is solid OLED black and can be resized — it picks the layout that fits.
m.set.background_help: Updates widgets and checks alerts. Android allows at most every 15 minutes; tap a widget's refresh icon for now.
m.set.private: Hide amounts on the portfolio widget
m.set.private_help: Shows only percentages, for a home screen others can see.
m.set.pin_unsupported: Your launcher cannot add widgets from apps. Long-press the home screen → Widgets → Maze Crypto.
m.set.exchanges_help: Prices come from the first ticked exchange that lists the pair (expert mode sets the order); CoinGecko and exchange rates fill the gaps.
m.set.no_exchange: No exchange selected — prices will come from CoinGecko only.
m.set.proxy_help: Use socks5h:// so DNS goes through the proxy too. Orbot's default is socks5h://127.0.0.1:9050.
m.set.expert_unlocks: Expert adds: Insights, RSI/MACD and more averages on the chart, market-cap and source details, every alert type, exchange priority, the Tor/SOCKS5 proxy, import/export and the yearly realised P/L report.
m.set.rerun_q: Show the setup again now? Your data is kept.
m.set.stored: Everything is stored on this phone only. No account, no cloud.
m.wiz.welcome_sub: Maze Crypto tracks markets, your portfolio and your buying plan — read-only and private — and puts your favorite coins on your home screen. Setup takes a minute; everything can be changed later.
m.wiz.watch_sub: Pick a starting list. ★ marks the coins your home-screen widgets show.
m.wiz.star_note: Any coin on CoinGecko can be added later. Stars can be changed any time in Prices.
m.wiz.widgets_b: After setup, long-press your home screen → Widgets → Maze Crypto, or use the button on the home page. Favorites shows your starred coins in a compact list.
m.about.credits_body: Market data: CoinGecko, Binance, Kraken, Coinbase, BtcTurk, Paribu, TCMB, ECB. Icons: Phosphor (MIT). Typeface: Inter (SIL Open Font License).
widget.empty_hold: Add a wallet address or a purchase in Maze Crypto to see your holdings here.
tip.start_trades.t: Add your wallet or first purchase
tip.start_trades.b: Paste a public wallet address and its balance is read from the blockchain — or enter what you bought to see profit and loss. Nothing connects to an exchange.
m.hold.unknown_cost: Profit/loss counts only coins with recorded buys. No buys recorded for: {coins}. Add trades for them to see it.
m.set.bg_never: No background refresh has run yet.
m.set.bg_last_failed: Last background refresh {age} ago had no network — showing older data.
m.set.bg_held: Android is holding this app's background work back (battery optimisation). Set the app's battery use to “Unrestricted” so widgets and wallet balances keep updating.
m.wal.title: Wallet
m.wal.empty_b: Paste the public address of any wallet — Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Hyperliquid, TRON, Litecoin and more. Its balance and transfers are read from the blockchain and your portfolio follows it. Add as many addresses per coin as you like.
m.wal.safe_b: Only public information is used — addresses, account keys (xpub) and, for Monero, the view key, which can see incoming payments but never spend. The app never asks for, stores or sends a recovery phrase or spending key, and cannot move funds.
m.wal.privacy_b: To read a balance the address is sent to a public blockchain explorer (Blockstream, Blockscout, Solana, TronGrid …), which can link it to your IP address. Turn on the Tor/SOCKS proxy in Settings (expert) to hide it. Addresses stay on this phone and are left out of cloud backups.
m.wal.history_failed: Transfers could not be loaded right now.
m.wal.history_partial: Some addresses' transfers could not be loaded.
m.wal.history_note: Values at today's price. Tap a transfer to open it in a block explorer. Zero-value and unknown-token transfers (often scam bait) are hidden.
m.wal.no_history_chain: Transfer history is shown for Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Hyperliquid, TRON and Litecoin addresses. For other networks, open the address in its explorer.
m.wal.no_history_chain_one: Balances on {chain} are read from a public node; its transfer history is in the explorer.
m.wal.address_ph: bc1…, 0x…, T…, Solana or Monero address
m.wal.address_help: Paste a public receiving address. The network is detected and the checksum verified.
m.wal.address_fixed: The address and network cannot be changed; delete the wallet and add a new one instead.
m.wal.networks_multi: Networks to check — the same address works on all of them
m.wal.l2_note: On this network balances (the coin and major stablecoins) are read; transfers open in the explorer.
m.wal.reference_help: Only for your reference. Never a recovery phrase or private key.
m.wal.xmr_note: Entered by hand. For a balance that follows the blockchain, add the wallet in the Monero tab with its private view key — it is scanned on this phone, over Tor.
m.wal.manual_note: A balance you enter yourself — for coins without a public lookup, or coins on an exchange. Update it when it changes.
m.wal.label: Name (optional)
m.wal.in_portfolio_help: Off = watch only, e.g. someone else's address.
m.wal.ignored: {n} other tokens hidden — unknown, without a price or a real market (e.g. airdropped meme tokens), flagged as scam or dust.
m.wal.indexer_price: Some tokens are priced by the chain's explorer (Blockscout / Jupiter), not CoinGecko.
m.wal.no_browser: No browser to open the link.
m.wal.err_stale: Showing the last known balance — update failed: {err}
m.wal.err_duplicate: This address is already added on {chain}.
m.wal.delete_b: Only the address is removed from the app. Nothing happens to the funds.
m.wal.coin_none: No wallet holds this coin yet. Add an address to follow its balance here and in your portfolio.
m.wal.secret_seed: That looks like a recovery phrase (seed words).
m.wal.secret_private_key: That looks like a private key.
m.wal.secret_xprv: That looks like an extended private key (xprv).
m.wal.secret_b: Anyone who has it can take your funds. It was not saved and has been cleared from the field and the clipboard. Maze Crypto only needs the public receiving address. If you pasted it into any other app or website, move your funds to a new wallet.
m.wal.bad_xpub: Not a valid extended public key.
m.wal.bad_testnet: That is a testnet address; only mainnet is supported.
m.wal.bad_checksum: The checksum does not match — a character is wrong or missing. Copy the address again.
m.wal.bad_unknown: Not a recognised address. Supported: Bitcoin, Ethereum and EVM networks, Hyperliquid, Solana, TRON, Litecoin, Monero.
m.wal.bad_not_xmr: That is not a Monero address.
hold.sub: Your wallets and trades, at live prices
m.hold.wallets_only: Amounts come from your wallets. Record your buys under Trades to also see profit and loss.
m.wal.secret_spend_key: That is the private SPEND key of this wallet, not the view key.
m.wal.valid_account: Valid account key — every address of this account will be watched.
m.wal.account_b: The account key gives every receiving and change address of the account, so the whole balance is followed — not just one address. It cannot spend. Check that the first address below matches your wallet.
m.wal.verify_hint: Before receiving a large amount, check the address on your Ledger (Ledger screen → Verify).
m.ledger.title: Add from Ledger
m.ledger.cta_b: Read your Ledger accounts over USB or Bluetooth — watch-only.
m.ledger.safe_b: Maze Crypto only asks your Ledger for public keys. It has no command that signs or sends anything, and your recovery phrase never leaves the device.
m.ledger.evm_nets: Watch the Ethereum accounts on these networks (same address):
m.ledger.usb_help: Nano S Plus, Nano X, Stax, Flex: a USB-C cable or an OTG adapter.
m.ledger.ble_help: Nano X, Stax, Flex. Turn Bluetooth on; the first time, confirm the pairing code on the Ledger.
m.ledger.steps_b: Unlock the Ledger with your PIN. The {app} app must be installed (Ledger Live → My Ledger); the app opens it for you if the device is on the dashboard — confirm on the device.
m.ledger.look_at_device: Keep the Ledger unlocked and watch its screen.
m.ledger.verify_on_device: Compare what the Ledger shows with the app, then approve on the device.
m.ledger.discovery_note: Accounts are found the way Ledger Live does: account 1, 2, 3 … until the first unused one.
m.ledger.err_locked: The Ledger is locked. Unlock it with your PIN and try again.
m.ledger.err_wrong_app: Open the {app} app on the Ledger and try again.
m.ledger.err_not_installed: The {app} app is not installed on this Ledger. Install it with Ledger Live (My Ledger).
m.ledger.err_no_device: No Ledger found. Check the cable / OTG adapter, or Bluetooth.
m.ledger.err_permission: USB access was not allowed. Plug the Ledger in again and allow Maze Crypto.
m.ledger.err_bt_permission: Bluetooth permission is needed to find a Ledger.
m.ledger.err_scan: Bluetooth search failed. Turn Bluetooth off and on, then try again.
m.ledger.err_pairing: Pairing did not finish. Confirm the code on the Ledger, or forget the device in Bluetooth settings and pair again.
m.ledger.err_timeout: The Ledger did not answer in time.
m.ledger.err_protocol: Unexpected answer from the Ledger. Update its firmware and apps with Ledger Live.
m.ledger.err_bad_request: The {app} app refused the request. Update it with Ledger Live.
m.ledger.err_status: The Ledger returned an error. Update the {app} app and try again.
m.xmr.address_help: The wallet's main address (starts with 4), not a subaddress.
m.xmr.view_key_help: 64 characters. Feather / Monero GUI: Wallet → Keys. Cake: Wallet keys. It can see incoming payments but cannot spend. Never enter the spend key or the seed.
m.xmr.restore: Wallet created on (date or block height)
m.xmr.restore_help: YYYY-MM-DD. Scanning starts there; older payments are not found. Earlier is safer but slower.
m.xmr.err_restore: Enter the date the wallet was created (YYYY-MM-DD) or a block height.
m.xmr.key_primary: Use the primary address (starts with 4). A view-only wallet cannot be made from a subaddress or an integrated address.
m.xmr.key_format: A view key is 64 hexadecimal characters.
m.xmr.key_mismatch: This view key does not belong to this address.
m.xmr.tor_b: Start Orbot first. Monero goes only through the Tor proxy at {host}:{port} (Settings → Tor) to onion nodes; with Tor off nothing is sent.
m.xmr.view_b: The view key stays on this phone, sealed by the Android Keystore; nodes only serve the same blocks to everyone. A view key sees incoming payments; spends are recognised by the change they return. A send of the whole balance without change is not seen — then the balance shows too much.
m.xmr.err_tor_off: Tor is not running. Start Orbot (or check the address in Settings → Tor).
m.xmr.err_tor_check: Could not confirm the connection goes through Tor.
m.xmr.err_not_tor: The proxy is not Tor. Monero is only synced over Tor.
m.xmr.err_node: The Monero node address is not valid.
m.xmr.err_node_http: A clearnet node must use https:// — or use an .onion node.
m.xmr.err_no_key: The view key is missing on this phone (backups do not carry it). Remove the wallet and add it again.
m.tor.title: Tor (Orbot) & Monero
m.tor.help: Monero always goes through Tor. Install Orbot and start it; its SOCKS port is 127.0.0.1 : 9050 by default.
m.tor.node_help: Empty = Maze's list of community onion nodes. Your own: xyz.onion:18081 or https://host:18089.
m.ledger.coins_help: Pick as many as you like: one connection reads them all. The app opens each coin's app on the Ledger in turn — you only confirm "open" on the device.
m.ledger.xmr_help: Monero: the date your Ledger Monero wallet was first used (YYYY-MM-DD). Scanning starts there.
m.ledger.steps_multi: Unlock the Ledger with your PIN and stay on its screen. The coin apps must be installed (Ledger Live → My Ledger). For Monero the Ledger asks to export the view key: allow it — it can only see incoming payments, never spend.
m.ledger.err_xmr_view_declined: The view key was not exported (declined on the Ledger), so Monero cannot be watched.
m.home.start_b: Paste a public address or account key, connect a Ledger, or enter a purchase. Nothing here can move funds.
m.sec.title: Privacy & security
m.sec.hide_b: Show •••••• instead of money values on the dashboard (also the eye on the portfolio card).
m.sec.screen_b: No screenshots, screen recording or recent-apps preview of Maze Crypto. Screens where a key is typed are always protected.
widget.wallets_empty: Add a wallet or a Ledger in Maze Crypto.
m.wal.dust_note: Tiny receipts marked Dust are often a tracking trick: do not spend them together with your other coins (freeze them in your wallet).
m.xmr.restore_auto: Not needed: recent payments appear first, then the history is read backwards. A date only makes it faster.
m.xmr.history_so_far: History read back to {date} · {n} payments found. The balance is complete once it reaches the wallet's first payment.
m.xmr.history_stopped: History read back to {date} ({n} payments) and stopped there.
m.xmr.history_wifi: Older history is read on Wi-Fi only (Settings → Tor & Monero).
m.tor.mobile_data: Read Monero history on mobile data
m.tor.mobile_data_b: Reading a wallet's past can take gigabytes (about 18 MB per day of history). Off = only on Wi-Fi; new blocks are always followed.
m.diag.title: Last freeze report
m.diag.sub: Tap to copy it, then send it to the developer. It holds only program stack frames — no addresses or keys.
m.xmr.tor_required_b: Monero is only checked over Tor, and nothing answers at {host}:{port}. Start Orbot (its SOCKS port is 127.0.0.1:9050), then come back — the wallet syncs on its own.
